overview: An interactive 3D molecule viewer that shows the final shape after lone-pair repulsion and lets you compare it with the idealised shape side by side.
features: Explore 26 molecules in an interactive 3D view
See the real shape after lone-pair repulsion, like Bent or Seesaw
Compare with and without lone pairs in a synchronised split view
Read the bond-angle change caused by lone pairs
Search molecules and filter by category
Toggle lone-pair markers and bond-angle overlays
